sections.content: Use porque to explain the cause of a completed past event. The main event and its reason can both be expressed with the pretérito indefinido: Se fue porque recibió una noticia. You can also put the reason first: Porque recibió una noticia, se fue.

items.spanish: Se fue porque recibió una noticia.
items.english: He left because he received some news.
She cried because she understood the situation.

items.spanish: Nos despedimos porque terminó el viaje.
items.english: We said goodbye because the trip ended.
He stayed because he wanted to talk.

sections.content: Use porque to give the reason. Use por eso to introduce the consequence. Do not use por eso when you mean because.
